data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure (venue search and suggestion, event pick, set times, update search), but it leaves out the sort option and the optional date, treats the amenity filter vaguely, and ends with "review listings" instead of Book Now. Its parameters are also coarse ("times" is not split into start and end, and "filters" is not specific), so an automation would need guesswork.
